identity.fantasy: A low-global elemental assassin who keeps Zenith and Smolder rolling while throwing Warpdaggers, cycling engravings, and cutting through targets with Runeblade.
identity.one_line: A mobile elemental assassin using Smolder, Runeblade, Warpdagger, Echo Rune, Runeshroud, and short-lived codices. It alternates Fire, Frost, Wind, and Water interactions and can place a Genesis damage-storage mark. Current players specifically call out Warpdagger and Echo Rune management on a low global cooldown.

mechanics.core_loop: Keep Zenith active, throw Warpdagger on cooldown for upgraded Smolder without necessarily teleporting, prioritize Hoarfrost, Smolder, Primordial Blast, and Hurricane, then use Runeblade as filler while aligning Primordial Fury with Zenith on bosses.
mechanics.single_target: Use Air weapon engraving, maintain Zenith and Smolder, and align Primordial Fury rather than spending it immediately.
mechanics.aoe: Switch to Earth engraving with Primordial Fury, then use the same fast priority around Smolder, Hurricane, and elemental effects.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Warpdagger, Phaser, clones, codices, and Surging Slash make it highly mobile, although the dagger may be thrown only for its buff rather than teleportation.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Runeshroud, disappearance, elemental codices, freezes, and assassin mobility provide avoidance-oriented defense.
mechanics.group_utility: Elemental control and Runemaster utility supplement a damage-first melee role.

failure_modes.text: Letting Zenith fall, delaying Warpdagger's upgraded Smolder, or using the wrong engraving for the encounter loses several overlapping multipliers on a very fast global cadence.

Movement or a target swap can interrupt the intended payoff: warpdagger, phaser, clones, codices, and surging slash make it highly mobile, although the dagger may be thrown only for its buff rather than teleportation.

Spending recovery or control too early leaves less protection for the next pressure event: runeshroud, disappearance, elemental codices, freezes, and assassin mobility provide avoidance-oriented defense.

append_claims.text: The August Riftblade PvE guide prioritizes Hoarfrost, Smolder, Primordial Blast, Hurricane, then Runeblade filler; it calls for near-continuous Zenith, Warpdagger on cooldown for upgraded Smolder without requiring the teleport, Air engraving for single target, Earth plus Primordial Fury for AoE, and boss alignment of Primordial Fury with Zenith. It says the current optimized build skips Riftblade capstones for Spellfire Runes and Elemental Inscription.
append_claims.notes: The author says best weapon testing was still in progress.

append_claims.text: Recent players describe Riftblade as very high APM and explicitly call out Warpdagger and Echo Rune management on a low global cooldown, alongside strong damage but survivability pressure.
append_claims.notes: Small discussion with unnormalized performance impressions.

append_claims.text: The July DPS compilation reports Riftblade at 4,370, and the August Mythic inventory lists 51 Riftblade records.
append_claims.notes: The sources are unnormalized and do not establish a tier rank.

append_claims.text: Riftblade has a compact priority but high execution cost because short globals and multiple upkeep states make missed actions compound across Zenith, Smolder, engravings, and elemental cooldowns.
append_claims.notes: Input rate and state density are separate from raw button count.
